description: This file defines an Android JobService implementation that processes enqueued work asynchronously, manages notifications, and handles job lifecycle events.

classes.name: JobWorkService
classes.description: An implementation of Android's JobService that processes queued work items asynchronously and manages notifications.

classes.name: CommandProcessor
classes.description: An AsyncTask subclass within JobWorkService that dequeues and processes work in the background.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up the notification manager, and shows a creation toast.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up notifications and shows a destruction toast when service is destroyed.

methods.name: onStartJob
methods.description: Starts processing work using CommandProcessor when the job starts.

methods.name: onStopJob
methods.description: Cancels ongoing work and requests job rescheduling if needed.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating the service is processing work.
